description:
## Why was the MyoAdapt patch removed?

MyoAdapt's core feature — its adaptive training engine, which plans your next workout based on your completed sessions — runs entirely on MyoAdapt's servers and is fed only by server-side workout history. For accounts without an active subscription, the server hard-blocks (HTTP 402) every action that records or updates a workout.

A client-side patch can fake the workout flow (start, log, finish a session), but the server never learns about any of it: no history, no stats, and the proposed next workout never changes. The patch could therefore never deliver the one thing MyoAdapt is actually worth using for — so rather than shipping something that promises premium but can't deliver it, it has been removed.
